items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Vega was a good trumpet player, any way you're looking.

ctx.x: He mentioned that you talked about Keppert, Perez, Vega.
No, no. There you go. I mean, that's what I mean. You see, none of them don't mention the white trumpet player. Vega? Vega was white.
